name: Surge 模块备份
description: 从 Surge HTTP API 拉取已安装模块并归档，可上传到 GitHub 后用 surge:///install-module 一键装回，还能按备份恢复启用状态。

localizedDescriptions.zh: 从 Surge HTTP API 拉取已安装模块并归档，可上传到 GitHub 后用 surge:///install-module 一键装回，还能按备份恢复启用状态。
localizedDescriptions.en: Back up installed Surge modules through the HTTP API, upload them to GitHub, and reinstall with surge:///install-module.
